richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tirunelveli

c: The Thamirabarani flows through Tirunelveli, but the district lies in the rain shadow of the Western Ghats and much of the year is hot and dry. Most rain comes with the northeast monsoon. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tirunelveli for schools, colleges, municipal parks, temple grounds and residential layouts. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,290 km away, and deliver by road.

The town has a strong education base, with many schools and colleges in Palayamkottai and around. Their grounds can each hold an open gym for students and staff. We plan the set from your photos and measurements, send a layout drawing with clear space marked, and install with our team or a dealer in south India. Municipal parks in the town are another good fit, especially those with an existing walking track.

Metal in full afternoon sun gets very hot in the dry months. Place the gym on the east side of a building or under a row of trees, so it is shaded in the evening when students are free. Roto-moulded seats and handles stay cooler than bare steel.

items.q: Do you supply schools and colleges in Palayamkottai?
items.a: Yes. We supply schools and colleges across Tirunelveli district. Share the ground size and number of students for a suggested layout and quote.

items.q: How do we stop the machines getting too hot?
items.a: Place them in shade, ideally on the east side of a building or under trees, and plan use for mornings and evenings. Moulded parts heat up less than bare metal.

items.q: Who maintains the equipment after installation?
items.a: Your own staff can handle routine care using the steps we share at handover. For parts or problems, call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.
